assistant|disposal_clean_baking_soda_vin: Pour 1/2 cup baking soda then 1 cup vinegar, let sit 1-2 hours, rinse with hot water
assistant|disposal_clean_ice_rock_salt: Grind ice cubes and 1 tablespoon rock salt with cold running water to scrub debris and odors
assistant|disposal_clean_lemon: Squeeze lemon juice into disposal with baking soda, or grind citrus pieces to deodorize
assistant|disposal_replacement_signs: Replace disposal if over 10-15 years old, frequent clogs, leaks, persistent odors, loud noise, or corrosion
assistant|disposal_troubleshooting: Jammed disposal: press reset button on bottom; clogs: drain snake or plunger
assistant|utensil_organization_tips: Purge duplicates, group similar items, assign homes, use dividers, keep frequent items front and center, use vertical space
assistant|utensil_holder_ideas: Mason jar, tiered, drawer dividers, wall-mounted, or rotating utensil holders
assistant|granite_scratch_diy_methods: Shallow scratches: baking soda paste, stone soap, mineral oil, or granite repair kit
assistant|granite_scratch_professional_r: Deep scratches: professional granite refinishing or epoxy filler
assistant|granite_care_tips: Use coasters/pads, cutting boards, and sealing; avoid harsh chemicals and use soft cloths
assistant|faucet_leak_fixes: Clean or replace aerator, O-rings, gaskets, valve seats; tighten loose handle screws
assistant|faucet_replacement_signs: Replace faucet if over 10-15 years old, frequent leaks, corrosion/mineral buildup, or parts unavailable
assistant|faucet_replacement_options: Single-handle, touchless, pull-out, or low-flow faucet options
assistant|slow_cooker_yogurt_steps: Heat milk to 180°F, cool to 110-120°F, add 1-2 tbsp starter, incubate on low/warm 6-8 hours or overnight, then chill
assistant|yogurt_troubleshooting: No formation means wrong temperature, insufficient time, or faulty starter; longer incubation makes thicker yogurt
assistant|nondairy_milk_options: Almond, soy, coconut, cashew, oat, rice, and hemp milks for non-dairy yogurt
assistant|nondairy_yogurt_tips: Use unsweetened milk, add thickener, use non-dairy starter, incubate at 100-110°F
assistant|thickener_tapioca_starch: Tapioca starch: 1-2 tbsp mixed with cold water or milk as a slurry
assistant|thickener_pectin: Pectin: 1-2 tbsp powder mixed with hot water to form a gel
assistant|thickener_agar_agar: Agar agar: 1-2 tbsp powder mixed with hot water; vegan gelatin alternative from red algae
assistant|thickener_guar_gum: Guar gum: 1/4-1/2 teaspoon mixed with cold water as a slurry
assistant|thickener_xanthan_gum: Xanthan gum: 1/4-1/2 teaspoon mixed with cold water as a slurry
